messages:
mei: Heads-up from onboarding smoke for northstar-v1 (quant=q6_n). Running our multilang translate suite and seeing punctuation mirroring + bracket swaps in zh-Hant-TW and fa-IR outputs. Pasting command and a couple of minimal repros.

oliver: repro steps please and a single failing sample so we can triage quickly.

mei: eval command I used:
```
./scripts/eval_onboard --model northstar-v1 --quant q6_n --suite multilang:translate_smoke --locales zh-Hant-TW,fa-IR,he-IL --out /tmp/northstar_q6n_smoke.jsonl
```

mei: sample A (zh-Hant-TW):
- src: "\u65e5\u671f\uff1a 7/21 (\u9031\u4e09)"
- ref: "Date: 7/21 (Wed)"
- northstar-q6n: "Date: 7/21 \uff09Wed\uff08"  <-- closing/open paren mirrored and order looks swapped

rahul: sample B (fa-IR):
- src: "(\u062a\u0627\u0631\u06cc\u062e) 03/09"
- ref: "(Date) 03/09"
- northstar-q6n: "(\u062a\u0627\u0631\u06cc\u062e] 03/09"  <-- replaced ) with ]

oliver: yikes. Could be detok normalization or bidi reordering in the postprocess. Can you paste token dumps pre- and post-detok?

mei: pre-detok token stream (from tokenizer debug):
```
["\u65e5\u671f\uff1a"," ","7","/","21"," ","(","\u9031","\u4e09",")"]
```
post-infer detok stream (northstar-q6n):
```
["\u65e5\u671f\uff1a"," ","7","/","21"," ","\uff09","\u9031","\u4e09","\uff08"]
```
(note: parens changed to fullwidth mirrored glyphs and positions swapped)

rahul: quick compare to baseline q8 variant? Are pre-detok tokens identical across q6_n and q8?

mei: yes, I reran tokenizer + model (no detok) and token streams are identical. So likely detok/post-normalization. Bisecting now between detok configs used in kernel_pack_2026-02-03 (q6_n) vs kernel_pack_2026-01-20 (q8).

Build-bot: /build meta model=northstar-v1 variant=q6_n kernel=kernel_pack_2026-02-03-9d2f

L10n-bot: /report locale_regression model=northstar-v1 quant=q6_n suite=multilang:translate_smoke delta_bleu_zhTW=-0.24 delta_bleu_fa=-0.63 samples=480

oliver: I grepped runtime/normalizers and saw an ICU fallback introduced in commit c3d7 -> e1f4 that flips mirror_pairs when using the new path. That would explain mirrored glyph substitution.

rahul: nice catch. If detok is using ICU bidi rewriting, mixing with our in-house mirror table can double-apply mirroring. Need to confirm whether q6_n detok build linked ICU_ENABLED=true.

mei: quick check: yes q6_n build metadata includes ICU_ENABLED=true; q8 build does not.

oliver: short-term mitigation: route affected locales (zh-Hant-TW, fa-IR, he-IL) to q8 variant until we either align ICU normalization or revert the ICU mirroring step. Proposed routing change below: 
```json
{"routing":{"locale_overrides":{"zh-Hant-TW":"northstar-v1-q8","fa-IR":"northstar-v1-q8","he-IL":"northstar-v1-q8"}}}
```

mei: created ticket ML-ONBOARD-650 with samples, token dumps, detok logs, and kernel pack diff. Adding eng-runtime and l10n for remediation.

L10n-bot: Added label: priority=P2 impact=customer-facing translations

rahul: long-term fix options: 1) disable ICU mirroring only for the detok pipeline, 2) harmonize mirror tables so ICU path uses same canonical pairs, or 3) canonicalize to codepoint-preserving detok that avoids glyph-level substitution. I'll prototype a patch that forces mirror_handling=OFF in detok config and run the smoke again.

oliver: if the patch is low-risk, ship hotfix to q6_n packs; otherwise keep routing in place and schedule hotfix release. Also let's extend smoke locales to include zh-HK and ar-SA to catch other mixed-script interactions.

mei: running the patch locally now. Will post results in ~30m. Keeping this thread as the source of truth for artifacts and bisect notes. Thanks. :mag:
